title: Taste of the Wild: Chocolate and Wine Pairings in the Alaskan
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Our Alaska Made Wine & Chocolate Tour stands out by offering intimate access to the heart of Alaska's culinary scene. It uniquely combines wine and chocolate tastings, providing a deep dive into local craftsmanship and flavors. This experience is enriched by stunning Alaskan landscapes, personal stories from our knowledgeable local guides, and a focus on sustainability and supporting local businesses. It's not just a tour; it's an immersive journey into Alaska's culture, history, and breathtaking beauty, designed to connect you with the local community and its traditions. Join us for an unforgettable exploration of Alaska's culinary delights and natural wonders, crafted for those who seek a deeper, more authentic travel experience.
